entities.title: Station
entities.summary: The station appearing near the planet, leaving for distance, the removal test and the launch scene.
entities.purpose: Places the station on launch (RULES B.10.2) and on approach (B.11.1), swaps it with the sun when it leaves (B.9.4), and gives the tick the removal-for-distance test.
boundaries: A feature: it uses capabilities and other features, never a use case (tests/layers.rs).
The station can never be destroyed.
